issues.title: Missing Leaf Files in Context
issues.why: The overview references 13 leaf files (01-13) as 'authoritative', but only 00, 01, 97, 98, and 99 are provided. A mediocre coder cannot implement specific component logic (e.g., Sidebar, Buttons) without them.
issues.fix: Provide the content for files 02 through 13 or merge their normative constraints into the overview.

issues.title: LocalStorage Failure Mode
issues.why: The FOUC script catches errors for blocked localStorage but 'fails open to light'. In high-contrast or dark-preference environments, this is a flash/accessibility failure.
issues.fix: Update the catch block to check window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches even if localStorage fails.

issues.title: Truncated Design Principles
issues.why: File 01-design-principles.md is truncated at the end of the provided context, losing potential implementation rules.
issues.fix: Ensure the full text of 01-design-principles.md is included within the context window.
